name: adapt_moved_module_javascript_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: the module the agent's first solution requires is MOVED to a new path between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger, old path deleted and new path created); the agent must update its require, not keep pointing at the old location
prompts: pricing/rules.js exports DISCOUNT via module.exports. Create checkout.js with a function applyDiscount(price) that returns price * (1 - DISCOUNT), requiring it from './pricing/rules'. Export as module.exports = { applyDiscount }.
pricing/rules.js has moved to config/rules.js (same DISCOUNT value). Update checkout.js's require to use the new location './config/rules' - do not keep requiring the old path.
